title: T-DXd ferroptosis co-lethality via SLC7A11 suppression: a predictive biomarker hypothesis for trastuzumab deruxtecan in HER2+ breast cancer
hypothesis_statement: Trastuzumab deruxtecan (T-DXd) payload delivery of topoisomerase I inhibitor (DXd) to HER2+ breast cancer cells induces ferroptosis as a co-lethal mechanism alongside its established DNA damage/apoptosis pathway — specifically by depleting GSH precursors through DXd-induced mitochondrial dysfunction that suppresses the cystine/glutamate transporter SLC7A11 (xCT) via the HER2-PI3K-NRF2 transcriptional axis (with a note that post-translational specificity claimed in the generator output is not supported; transcriptional mechanism via NRF2 is the supported pathway). HER2+ tumors with low baseline SLC7A11 expression are therefore disproportionately sensitive to T-DXd, while HER2+ tumors with high SLC7A11 expression (the ferroptosis-escape phenotype) acquire partial T-DXd resistance via ferroptosis evasion independent of topoisomerase I mutation or drug efflux. SLC7A11 protein expression by IHC in pre-treatment HER2+ biopsies predicts T-DXd clinical benefit, stratifying HER2+ patients into ferroptosis-competent (SLC7A11-low, high T-DXd sensitivity) versus ferroptosis-escaped (SLC7A11-high, lower T-DXd sensitivity and early resistance) populations.
mechanism: DXd inhibits topoisomerase I → DNA replication fork collapse + mitochondrial DNA damage (via mitochondrial topoisomerase I) → Complex I/III ROS increase → lipid peroxidation → ferroptosis window opens when HER2 is internalized (HER2→PI3K→NRF2→SLC7A11/GPX4 signaling reduced transcriptionally). Cells with constitutively high SLC7A11 (independent of HER2/PI3K, driven by alternative KEAP1/NRF2, ATF4, or STAT3 axes) escape this window. EVALUATOR NOTE: post-translational SLC7A11 suppression claim in generator output is not mechanistically supported; transcriptional NRF2-mediated downregulation is the supported mechanism.
key_drugs: DXd (exatecan derivative, topoisomerase I inhibitor payload)

evidence_base.citation: Modi S et al., NEJM 2020, DESTINY-Breast01
evidence_base.note: T-DXd ORR 60.9% in HER2+ refractory BC; resistance mechanism not fully characterized — establishes the clinical gap

evidence_base.citation: Cortes J et al., NEJM 2022, DESTINY-Breast03
evidence_base.note: T-DXd vs T-DM1 PFS benefit confirmed; predictive biomarkers explicitly stated as undefined — establishes unmet need for biomarker development

evidence_base.citation: Koppula P et al., Mol Cancer Res 2021
evidence_base.note: SLC7A11/xCT regulated by NRF2 and suppressed by PI3K pathway inhibition; HER2 signaling maintains NRF2-driven SLC7A11 in HER2+ breast cancer — the single direct mechanistic citation for the HER2-PI3K-NRF2-SLC7A11 axis
GPX4 inhibition triggers ferroptosis; lipid peroxidation as executor — supports the ferroptosis biology framework but not T-DXd specific

evidential_gaps: DXd causing mitochondrial ROS or Complex I/III dysfunction — inferred, not directly cited in any cancer model
Topoisomerase I inhibition driving mitochondrial DNA damage specifically — plausible (mitochondrial TOP1 exists) but not demonstrated for DXd
HER2 internalization reducing NRF2-SLC7A11 specifically in T-DXd-treated cells — inferential chain across 3 steps
SLC7A11 baseline expression heterogeneity in TCGA-BRCA HER2+ subset — not systematically published; must be verified before biomarker premise is valid

arm_1_in_vitro_ferroptosis.description: T-DXd dose-response in HER2+ cell lines correlated with baseline SLC7A11 expression; ferrostatin-1 rescue to isolate ferroptotic component from apoptotic/DNA damage components
arm_1_in_vitro_ferroptosis.gaps_to_close_first: Confirm SLC7A11 expression rank order across these 4 cell lines by Western blot before committing to dose-response matrix

arm_2_genetic_overexpression.description: SLC7A11-OE via lentiviral transduction in T-DXd-sensitive lines (expected: BT-474, SKBR3) to test whether SLC7A11 elevation is sufficient to confer partial T-DXd resistance
arm_2_genetic_overexpression.note: This is the causal test of the biomarker premise — OE must shift T-DXd IC50 to validate SLC7A11 as a resistance driver

arm_3_clinical_retrospective.description: DESTINY-Breast01 and DESTINY-Breast03 biobank pre-treatment biopsies: SLC7A11 IHC H-score vs PFS/ORR
arm_3_clinical_retrospective.primary_endpoint: SLC7A11 IHC H-score correlation with PFS
arm_3_clinical_retrospective.prerequisite: Biobank access and collaboration agreement with AstraZeneca/Daiichi Sankyo
arm_3_clinical_retrospective.gap: No H-score dichotomization threshold defined — must be determined empirically from cohort distribution or literature precedent for SLC7A11 IHC in breast cancer

reflexion_recommended.query_1: Topoisomerase I inhibitor (camptothecin/SN-38/irinotecan/DXd) induced mitochondrial ROS and ferroptotic signatures in any cancer model — would close the mitochondrial-ROS step
reflexion_recommended.query_2: SLC7A11 expression heterogeneity in HER2+ breast cancer (TCGA-BRCA HER2-amplified subset) — would validate the biomarker stratification premise
reflexion_recommended.estimated_composite_after_reflexion: 0.79-0.83 if both queries confirm mechanistic links

dome_context.slc7a11_prior_work: hyp-ilc-003 confirmed SLC7A11 methylation as a publication gap in ILC (orthogonal histology); this hypothesis is orthogonal — drug-induced functional suppression in HER2+ is a distinct mechanism from basal methylation-driven silencing in ILC. No overlap.
dome_context.calibration_relative_to_dome: Composite 0.772 is below dome mean (0.785) but above ACCEPT_HIGH threshold; evidential_quality (0.58) is dome minimum — same floor as eval-hyp-ilc-006 before reflexion upgrade

key_evaluator_disagreement: Generator plausibility 0.74 vs evaluator plausibility 0.68 — the post-translational SLC7A11 suppression claim is likely mechanistically incorrect; NRF2 is a transcription factor and the PI3K-NRF2 axis would suppress SLC7A11 transcriptionally. This overspecification reduces plausibility without evidence.
